facts.fact: TechTrends Africa reports the NDPC, led by National Commissioner and CEO Dr Vincent Olatunji, directed unregistered Data Controllers and Processors of Major Importance to register after winning a Federal High Court case; article dated 28 July 2026.

The court rejected a bid to exempt PoS agents from classification as Data Controllers or Processors of Major Importance and refused to restrain their registration; the article gives no judgment date and is dated 28 July 2026.
